description: OpenProblems v1 single-cell RNA-seq denoising datasets, as used by the TTT-Discover biology experiment (arXiv:2601.16175). Train on pancreas; report on held-out PBMC (and Tabula) splits.

source.benchmark: Open Problems in Single-Cell Analysis (Luecken et al., 2025)
source.license: Public OpenProblems benchmark redistribution; individual source datasets carry their own licenses (10x Genomics PBMC, pancreas atlas). Public research data only, not PHI. See benchmark_url.

train_env.note: TTT-Discover trains the policy in-environment on pancreas.

held_out.note: Performance reported on held-out PBMC (and Tabula) splits.

denoising_metric.primary: mean of normalized MSE and normalized Poisson in log-normalized space
denoising_metric.construction: Observed molecules of a single dataset are partitioned into train/test via binomial sampling; no external ground truth required.
